title: The golden workbook's cached values for the circular revolver/interest block are not converged and contradict their own formulas, so a correctly recalculated output cannot match them within 1%.
evidence: Golden LBO N124 (=+N133) = 156.04 but N133 = 162.85, a 4.2% gap. M124 = 168.07 vs M133 = 174.48. L124 = 177.76 vs L133 = 183.75. K124 = 191.21 vs K133 = 195.54. N125 (=SUM(N123:N124)) is stored as 0 but the stored inputs give -6.8. LibreOffice recalculation of output.xlsx will give self-consistent values for these cells.
